text.p: UGI Corp said Tuesday its shareholders re-elected at their annual meeting all nine members of its board and approved a long-term incentive compensation plan for senior executives.
Shareholders also approved a directors' equity compensation plan and ratified the appointment of Coopers & Lybrand LLP as independent accountants for fiscal 1997.
Lon Greenberg, chairman, president and chief executive officer of the company, told shareholders UGI will focus on new opportunities for growth in fiscal 1997.
Current changes in the utility and energy markets create many opportunities for growth and UGI is positioned at the forefront of this potential, Greenberg said.
UGI is a holding company with subsidiaries in propane marketing, utility and energy marketing subsidiaries.
